versions.notes:
Add Windows x64 packaging and release support.

- Builds and verifies a Windows x64 PyInstaller package alongside the existing macOS arm64 package.
- Publishes macOS and Windows ZIP assets into the public downloads repo from the same tagged release.
- Adds platform-specific update manifests so Windows builds check `updates/windows-x64.json`.
- Keeps the public downloads table grouped by version with separate macOS, Windows, and Linux columns.

Fix macOS update checking and improve the public downloads page.

- Bundle a trusted certificate store for macOS update manifest checks.
- Add an All Versions link from the app info dialog with the current version in the URL.
- Highlight newer releases on the public downloads page when opened with a current version.
- Show long release notes with a short summary and expandable details.

Add the app information dialog and localized update controls.

- Add a header Info button with English and Turkish labels.
- Show application version, update channel, downloads, manifest, and credits.
- Add manual update checking from the app info dialog.

Initial public macOS updater release.

- Add the private-to-public release workflow for macOS arm64.
- Publish GitHub Release ZIP assets, SHA-256 metadata, and update manifests.
- Add the public downloads table with preserved previous versions.
